title: ScanSubmitted v1
description: A scan was accepted and durably stored. Emitted inside the same transaction that saves the Scan (ADR-004) — so this event existing means the scan exists, with no window where one is true and the other is not.

photoRef.description: An object-storage REFERENCE, never the image bytes. Keeps the queue light, and keeps photo lifecycle governed by one system's TTL policy (NFR-4) instead of scattered across every consumer that received a copy.

tier.description: Carried on the event because it selects WHICH MODEL the worker calls (PD-3). Re-reading entitlement at processing time would let a mid-flight upgrade change which vendor ran, making the result unreproducible.
